license_note: Meta publishes the weights under the custom Llama 4 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy. The policy states that the rights for multimodal Llama 4 models are not granted to individuals domiciled in or companies based in the European Union, so public weights do not make this an open-source distribution. Identical terms to the reviewed Maverick record.

license_evidence.scope: Llama 4 Scout 17B 16E Instruct weights, tokenizer, processor configuration, and related Llama materials
Acceptable-use policy and European Union multimodal exclusion incorporated by reference into the Llama 4 Community License

access_boundary: This record represents the meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct BF16 release dated April 5, 2025 (17B active, 109B total MoE, 10M context). The Scout base model, Llama 4 Maverick, the FP8 Maverick checkpoint, quantizations, fine-tunes, Meta-hosted products, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Meta publishes Transformers-compatible Safetensors shards with tokenizer, processor, and chat-template files in one pinned repository
The model card names the governing license, the base model, the release date, and distinguishes the Scout BF16 release from the Maverick and FP8 variants
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind identity disclosure and the incorporated policy withholds the multimodal grant from European Union entities
The model card documents a single Transformers path and no hosted serving paths
